description:
Bill the same client every month without lifting a finger: in Zoho Books go to Sales > Recurring Invoices > + New (if the module is hidden, enable Recurring Invoice in Settings > General). Pick the customer, give the profile a name, choose Repeat Every (week, month, year or Custom), add items, notes and terms, and Save. Each new invoice is saved as a draft or sent to the customer depending on your Recurring Invoice Preferences. To convert an existing invoice, open it, click the More icon and choose Make Recurring.

lines: Sending the same invoice to the same client every month? Let Zoho Books do it for you.
Set it up once as a recurring invoice, and the next ones are created on schedule.
In Zoho Books, go to Sales, then Recurring Invoices.
Click New. Don't see the module? Turn on Recurring Invoice under Settings, General.
Pick the customer, name the profile, and choose Repeat Every: a week, a month, a year, or a custom interval.
Add your items, notes and terms, and click Save.
Each new invoice is saved as a draft or sent to the customer, based on your recurring invoice preferences.
Already have the invoice? Open it, click the More icon, and choose Make Recurring.
